description: This file contains the implementation of the EmailService interface, providing methods to send HTML emails, retrieve, and save email configurations associated with a merchant store.

classes.name: EmailServiceImpl
classes.description: Implements email-related functionalities such as sending HTML emails and managing email configurations for merchant stores.

methods.name: sendHtmlEmail
methods.description: Sends an HTML email to the specified merchant store using configured email settings.

methods.name: getEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves email configuration for a given merchant store, parsing JSON stored in the database.

methods.name: saveEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Serializes the EmailConfig to JSON and saves or updates it for the given merchant store.
